title: The age of the spice trade. Word comes that a sea road to the Indies has been found, and pepper and cinnamon are worth more than ever. Ishbīliya and al-Ushbūna are among the seven markets of the West that become ports of the spice trade, with Genoa, Constantinople, Barcelona, Bordeaux and Naples

data.event: Spice Trade: the discovery of the East Indian Trade Route has ushered in the age of the Spice Trade; with new trade routes available, controlling the flow of spices like pepper or cinnamon has become more important than ever (the game's text)
